data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 签售会的作家真身·「要签名？先把感想写满一页」
data.description: 【书店签售会·周末】作家霞诗子的签售队伍排到了店门口。诗羽端坐在签到台后，钢笔在她指间转了一个华丽的弧度，红瞳扫过脸红到耳根的你——「哦呀，最忠实的读者先生来了。要签名可以……不过先把这一卷的感想写满一页纸，本作家只给认真的读者落笔。」
data.action: 端坐签到台转钢笔，红瞳扫过读者微笑宣判
data.camera: medium shot, signing table, pen twirl, authorial poise
data.promptProse: Kasumigaoka Utaha sits behind the signing table of her book event as the queue spills out the store door, twirling her fountain pen in a graceful arc. Her red eyes sweep over your blush-red ears as she offers her terms: a signature only for readers who fill a full page with their impressions, delivered with the effortless poise of the author behind the pen name Kasumi Utako. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, interior glow, detailed bookstore background.
